title: Relocating for a Spouse's Career
paragraphs: Ketika istrinya menerima kesempatan karier yang signifikan di negara lain, Idris menghadapi keputusan sulit meninggalkan kariernya yang sudah mapan dan jaringan sosialnya untuk mendukung kemajuan profesional istrinya sebagai gantinya.

Beberapa bulan pertama di negara baru itu terbukti benar-benar mengisolasi, karena Idris berjuang membangun kembali koneksi profesional sementara istrinya langsung tenggelam dalam posisi barunya yang menuntut.

Alih-alih membenci ketidakseimbangan itu, Idris menggunakan masa transisi itu untuk mengeksplorasi peluang lepas yang sebelumnya kurang fleksibel untuk ia kejar selama pekerjaannya yang lebih konvensional.

Dua tahun kemudian, baik Idris maupun istrinya sepakat bahwa relokasi itu, meski awalnya membingungkan, akhirnya menguntungkan keluarga mereka lebih daripada tetap tinggal dalam keadaan sebelumnya yang lebih nyaman tapi terbatas.
answerKey: When his wife received a significant career opportunity in another country, Idris faced the difficult decision of leaving his established career and social network to support her professional advancement instead. The first few months in the new country proved genuinely isolating, as Idris struggled to rebuild professional connections while his wife immersed herself immediately in her demanding new position. Rather than resenting the imbalance, Idris used the transition period to explore freelance opportunities he had previously lacked the flexibility to pursue during his more conventional employment. Two years later, both Idris and his wife agree that the relocation, though initially disorienting, ultimately benefited their family more than remaining in their previous, more comfortable but limiting circumstances would have.
